# DiskSizer

> Disk full. Of what? Find the files eating your storage, preview what is inside, and decide what stays.

A Windows disk space explorer with global file search, previews, allocation accounting, visual maps, and saved scans.

Current version: 1.1.0. Download the Windows x64 ZIP, extract it, and run DiskSizer.exe. Windows 10 or 11 is required. The build is unsigned.

Find files by name, category, and modification age. Logical and on-disk sizes are separate; folder allocation deduplicates known file identities. Unknown allocation is reported explicitly. Allocation is not a guarantee of reclaimable space.

Scans save automatically to disk. Saved scans are dated and read-only; rescan before deleting files. Previews read the current file at the stored path. Saved databases consume disk space until removed.

A native Windows metadata cursor and a separate SQLite-backed scan helper keep records off the JavaScript heap. Persistent indexing adds disk usage and write time. MFT acceleration, USN refresh, and snapshot comparison are not implemented.

Repeated version 1.1.0 test-folder scans of 14,950 files and 1,895 directories took 2.197, 2.188, and 2.100 seconds, including allocation metadata and indexing but excluding discovery and final UI rendering. Cold-cache conditions were not controlled. No competitive speed advantage has been measured.
